user.title: Add Sofar Inverter
user.description: Enter the Modbus TCP connection details for your Sofar inverter. Control features require the inverter to be set to Passive Mode.

data.name: Name
data.enable_control: Enable battery control (Passive Mode required). When off, only standard Modbus reads are sent: no heartbeat, commands, schedule, clock or event-log requests
data.enable_schedule: Enable Timing / Time-of-Use schedule entities (ME3000SP and HYD-ES only; requires battery control)
data.enable_clock_monitor: Monitor the inverter clock (recommended when using schedules; requires battery control)

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the inverter. Check the IP address and port.
error.invalid_slave: Connected, but could not read from the inverter. Check the Slave/Unit ID and model.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the logs for details.

abort.already_configured: An inverter with this IP, port and Slave ID is already configured.

init.title: Sofar Inverter options
init.description: Change polling and feature settings. Connection details and inverter model cannot be changed here — remove and re-add the integration if those need to change.
